Cookie Policy

Last updated: 15 October 2026

1. About this policy

This policy explains how OneHuman Inc. ("OneHuman", "we", "us") uses cookies and similar technologies on onehuman.ai, including the dashboard at onehuman.ai/portal. It does not cover the onehumanai software that our customers run on their own servers. That software is described on our Trust and privacy page.

2. What cookies are

Cookies are small text files that a website stores in your browser. Similar technologies, such as local storage and session storage, keep data in your browser in the same way. In this policy, "cookies" refers to all of them.

3. Essential cookies

Essential cookies are required for the site to work. They cannot be switched off in our cookie settings. We do not use them for advertising or to follow you across other websites.

NamePurposeDuration
oh_sidKeeps your session together while you use the live demos.Until you close your browser
oh_portalKeeps you signed in to the dashboard.30 days
oh_portal_sidProtects your dashboard session with our own product.Until you close your browser
Firebase AuthenticationSigns you in to the dashboard. Set by Google Firebase, our sign-in provider.Until you sign out

Two further cookies, oh_admin and oh_lab, are set only for OneHuman staff on internal pages.

4. Preferences stored in your browser

These items remember choices you make on the site. They are kept in your browser's local storage and are not sent to us.

NamePurposeDuration
oh_consentRemembers your cookie choices.Until you change them or clear your browser data
oh-chat-v1Keeps your conversation with the website chat, if you use it.Until you clear your browser data
oh-theme
oh-side
oh-portal-banner
oh-selftest		Remember your dashboard display settings.Until you clear your browser data

5. Optional cookies

Optional cookies are used only if you allow them.

CategoryPurposeProvider
Embedded videosPlays videos on our pages, such as the demo on the homepage. The player loads only after you allow it in cookie settings or choose "Play video". YouTube may then store cookies or similar data in your browser.YouTube (Google), from youtube-nocookie.com. See the Google Privacy Policy.

The preview image of a video is loaded from YouTube's image server (i.ytimg.com) before you allow the player. Loading the image does not place cookies in your browser.

6. What we do not use

  • Advertising or marketing cookies.
  • Third-party analytics. We count visits on our own server without any cookie. The Trust and privacy page lists what that record contains.
  • Cookies that track you across other websites.

Fonts are loaded from Google Fonts, which does not set cookies.

7. Your choices

You can change your choices at any time with Cookie settings, also linked at the bottom of every page. You can also block or delete cookies in your browser settings. If you block essential cookies, the live demos and the dashboard will not work.

8. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy when the site changes. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last updated.

9. Contact

OneHuman Inc. For questions about this policy, write to arif@onehuman.ai.
